data.description: Find a way in. Overload the reactor core. Get out again in five minutes - before it all goes boom! Sounds easy right? After all, you've survived a nuclear war and now it's payback time for Klaus Von Klensch, mastermind of the apocalypse! With only a handful of items (Plasma Pistol, EMP grenade, Locator, Adrenochrome Booster, and of course Toilet Brush) you're gonna need some serious attitude to succeed in your mission. Stealthy, shooty, sweary, oldskool arcadey action - with a daily random bunker!

changelog.change_log:
Improved UI and keypad on Security Reboot Terminal.
Improved UI and keypad on Blast Door Override Terminal.
Improvements to Sentry Bot material and textures.

'Raspberry Pi' Sentry bots (better visibility, particularly in dark areas than the original dark red ones).

'Green Absynth' Klaus-Spider pods (now with added fizz). 

Random bunker selection randomizes only when the Random icon is selected, not on game start (allows you to retry the same random bunker).

Biodome now contains water - and you know what lurks in that.

Computer Room Security Reboot terminal now has shorter time limit for key entry.

Fixed: View does not fade to black when head intersects scenery.

Fixed: Breathing SFX continues on player death.

Updated: Item glow (now magenta) fades out when items are distant.

VO "just a scratch" now plays at 50% health

Improved Reactor core lighting.

Improved bunker exterior lighting and skybox.

Improved Damage VFX - 'faces of pain' flash effect.

Fixes bug where player can fall through wall colliders in a room.
Improved entry corridor visuals to computer room.
CCTV cameras improved texturing.

Improvements to sewer chamber.
Various small tweaks & improvements.

Some texture & lighting improvements.
Bunker intercom now on right side of entrance.

Visual improvements to lockers, security access door, some other parts of bunker environment.

Tall lockers: added new 'hidey' hint note with some backstory.

New default 'Tested' bunker (not too hard, lots of lockers, computer room & blast door) 

Fixed very rare bug where elevator does not descend into bunker.

Fixed: Items dropped in elevators no longer fall through the floor when elevator reaches destination.

Started using larger texture atlas for environment - not much to see at present but will allow more detail to be added.

Tall lockers: added hiding-place hint note and locker number on door.

HUD: slightly lower positioning for better visibility

+ first pass bunker-busted outro sequence
+ improved main menu / simplified in game menu
+ fixed bug where replaying a level Klaus doesn't answer the intercom / can't get in
+ added new VO lines

Added Achievements * 
Added High Score *
* stored locally on device, not yet integrated with Meta's Achievements
Fixed various small bugs.

Fixes a bug with version 0.3.3 which prevents player exiting the bunker.
Minor improvements to Spider clone tank.

Added 2 'hideout' areas - entering will throw sentries off your tail.
Minor bug fixes and improvements.

Hiding behind locker doors now throws sentries off your trail.
Minor tweaks to various geometry.

Fixed: wall with missing collider
Added: Mech now shoots physics projectiles
Added: Door glass now breaks when shot
Added: Barrels are now destructible and cause damage when exploding

Elevator control panels improved.
Added Smooth Rotation option in Player Settings.
Small tweaks & fixes.

Replaced: Toilet brush (aquamarine, used) > toilet brush (red, clean).
Collision SFX added to Locator.
Added player VO for big falls.
Updated: Plasma Pistol ammo display red when depleted
Fixed Bug: Player can exit elevator when doors are shut
Added: Elevator in Reactor Core (now you don't have to climb all the way to the upper level - but you will miss the bonus Health pickup)!

Added depth to start Scene logo.
Bug fixed: Headshot can no longer be triggered if you first hit body of Sentry. 
Improvements to environment / room layouts.
Optimised more colliders.
Fixed several issues with VO and audio.

First pass scoring, You now get points for: 

Staying hidden (increments till seen)
Shooting stuff
Overloading the reactor
Escaping

Updated Main Menu:
Select Bunker now has Random, Daily, and Certified-Tested options.

Added more VO.
Improvements to environment / room layouts.
Optimised some colliders.

Added warm-up sfx to give warning before Mech shoots.

Crates now provide shelter from damage when Mech shoots.

Improved hangar crane controls - added targeting display.

Replaced Sentry shoot sfx.

Replaced Menu button click sfx.

Replaced Mech foot stomp sfx.

Various small tweaks.
